policy: Consume complete selected P4 Opus under the actual opening policy. No command crop, word list, system prompt, transcript or vocabulary bias. English language, greedy decoding. Count closed cases as incomplete. Same normalized complete-suffix test as the stored Whisper baselines. Separately read eight dry positive controls and 20 prefixes ending at the nominal command clock before the 90 ms FIFO delay for the transmitted microphone.
